snippet.title: Hoarder - Release Date Reveal Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3551140/Hoarder/
A release date trailer for Hoarder. Clean. Possess. Control. HOARDER begins as a mundane cleaning simulator which spirals into a submerged nightmare. Pilot a submarine, recover what shouldn’t be found, and uncover the secrets of your new home by night.
